# UyirKappan — Combined Dataset Bundle (10 datasets)

Generated synthetic + static datasets for the UyirKappan emergency-dispatch prototype.
Each section below is one dataset: a title, a one-line description, and the full CSV content
in a fenced code block. Split each block back into its own `.csv` file using the title as the
filename if a downstream tool needs individual files.

---

## 1. Static Master Dataset — Hospitals & Ambulance Bases

**File name:** `chennai_healthcare_dispatch_dataset.csv`  
**Description:** The original Chennai infrastructure dataset: 30 hospitals + 40 ambulance bases with lat/lon, priority, coverage areas, and deployment rationale. This is the static foundation everything else is derived from.
